chapterInfo.content:
17
Sakasakayɛ ba Tesalonika
1 # 1 Te 2.2 Na wɔtwaa mu wɔ Amfipoli ne Apolonia baa Tesalonika; ɛhɔ na Yudafoɔ hyiadan wɔ. 2Na sɛdeɛ Paulo taa yɛ no, ɔkɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn homeda mmiɛnsa ne wɔn kɔyɛɛ twerɛ nsɛm ho mpɛnsɛnpɛnsɛm. 3#Luka 24.26-27; 24.45-46 Ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ mu dii ho adanseɛ sɛ ɛtwa sɛ Kristo no hunu amane, na ɔsɔre firi awufoɔ mu. Na ɔse: Yesu a meka mo ne ho asɛm yi ara ne Kristo no. 4Na wɔn mu binom gye dii, na wɔde wɔn ho bɔɔ Paulo ne Silas ho, wɔne Helafoɔ nyamesurofoɔ no mu pii ne mmaa mpanimfoɔ no mu fa kɛseɛ.
5Na Yudafoɔ no ani bereeɛ, na wɔfaa ahuhufoɔ no mu nnipa bɔne bi kaa wɔn ho, na wɔmaa nkurɔfoɔ no bɔɔ bum bɛhyiae, na wɔdanee kuro no ani butui, na wɔkɔtwaa Yason dan ho hyiaeɛ, hwehwɛɛ sɛ wɔyi wɔn firi adi de wɔn kɔma nkurɔfoɔ no. 6#Aso 16.20 Na wɔanhu wɔn no, wɔtwee Yason ne anuanom no bi kɔmaa kuro no mu mpanimfoɔ, na wɔteateaa mu sɛ: Yeinom a wɔadane wiase ani abutuo no aba ha nso! 7#Luka 23.2 Na Yason agye wɔn. Nso wɔn nyinaa bu Kaesare mmara no so ka sɛ, ɔhene foforɔ bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no Yesu. 8Na nkurɔfoɔ no ne ɔman mpanimfoɔ no tee yei no, ɛhaa wɔn pa ara. 9Na Yason ne wɔn a aka no dii agyinamu maa wɔn no, wɔgyaa wɔn ma wɔkɔe.
Paulo ne Silas kɔ Beroia
10Na ntɛm ara anuanom no gyaa Paulo ne Silas kwan anadwo kɔɔ Beroia; na wɔduruu hɔ no, wɔkɔɔ Yudafoɔ hyiadan mu. 11#Yoh 5.39 Yudafoɔ a ɛwɔ ha no yɛ animdefoɔ sene wɔn a wɔwɔ Tesalonika no, ɛfiri sɛ wɔyii wɔn yam pefee gyee asɛm no, na daa na wɔhwehwɛ twerɛsɛm no mu sɛ nnoɔma no te saa anaa. 12Enti wɔn mu bebree gye dii, wɔne Helafoɔ mmaa a wɔwɔ din ne mmarima no mu fa kɛseɛ ara.
13 # 1 Te 2.14 Na Yudafoɔ a wɔfiri Tesalonika no tee sɛ Paulo akɔka Nyankopɔn asɛm Beroia nso no, wɔbaa hɔ bɛhwanyanee ɛhɔfoɔ no nso. 14#Aso 16.1 Enti ntɛm ara na anuanom no gyaa Paulo kwan sɛ ɔnkɔ mpoano; na Silas ne Timoteo deɛ, wɔtenaa hɔ. 15Na wɔn a wɔkɔgyaa Paulo no de no kɔɔ Atene. Ɔkraa wɔn sɛ Silas ne Timoteo mmra ne nkyɛn ntɛmntɛm no, wɔsii mu kɔe.
Paulo ne Yudafoɔ ne Helafoɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ
16Na Paulo retwɛn wɔn wɔ Atene na ɔhunuu sɛ kuro no de wɔn ho ama abosonsom no, ɛyɛɛ no ahometeɛ pa ara. 17Enti hyiadan mu, na ɔne Yudafoɔ ne nyamesurofoɔ no yɛɛ nhwehwɛmu dendeenden, na edwa mu nso, daa na ɔne wɔn a ɔbɛto wɔn no dii anobaebaeɛ. 18#1 Ko 4.12 Na Epikurofoɔ ne Stoafoɔ anyansapɛfoɔ bi nso ne no di anobaebaeɛ. Ebinom kaa sɛ: Ɔpɔtɔni yi se deɛn nie? Na ebinom se: Wayɛ sɛdeɛ ɔka abosom ahɔhoɔ bi ho asɛm. (Na ɔreka wɔn Yesu ne owusɔreɛ ho asɛmpa no.) 19Ɛnna wɔfaa no de no kɔɔ Areopago kaa sɛ: Wobɛtumi akyerɛ yɛn nkyerɛkyerɛ foforɔ yi ase? 20Ɛfiri sɛ nsɛm a wode aba yi yɛ yɛn aso mu asɛm foforɔ. Enti yɛpɛ sɛ yɛhunu deɛ ɛkyerɛ. 21Nso Atenefoɔ ne ahɔhoɔ a wɔabɛtena hɔ nyinaa nni hwee yɛ sɛ wɔbɛka anaa wɔbɛte asɛm foforɔ bie.
22Na Paulo gyinaa Areopago mfimfini kaa sɛ: Atene mmarima, mahunu sɛ mowɔ gyidie wɔ nnoɔma pii mu dodo. 23Ɛfiri sɛ meretwa mu na mehwɛɛ nnoɔma a mosom no, mehunuu afɔrebukyia bi nso a wɔatwerɛ so sɛ: Onyame a wɔnni no dea. Enti deɛ monnim na mosɔre no no, ɔno na meka ne ho asɛm mekyerɛ mo yi. 24#Aso 7.48 Onyankopɔn a ɔyɛɛ wiase ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa, ɔno ara a ɔyɛ ɔsoro ne asase wura no, ɔnte asɔredan a wɔde nsa ayɛ mu, 25#Dwom 50.12 nanso wɔmfa nnipa nsa nsom no sɛ deɛ ɛhia no biribie. Ɔno na ɔma nnipa nyinaa nkwa ne ahome ne ade nyinaa; 26#Deut 32.8 na ɔmaa nnipa wɔ aman nyinaa firi onipa baako mu tenaa asase so nyinaa, na wahyehyɛ mmerɛ ahodoɔ ne wɔn tenabea hyeɛ ato hɔ ama wɔn 27#Yes 55.6 sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ Awurade sɛ ebia wɔbɛte ne nka na wɔahu no, nso ɔne yɛn mu biara ntam kwan nware. 28Na ɔno mu na yɛte ase, na yɛkeka yɛn ho, na yɛwɔ hɔ, sɛdeɛ mo nnwontofoɔ binom nso aka sɛ:
Ɛfiri sɛ n’abusua nso ne yɛn.
29 # Gye 1.27; Yes 40.18 Na ɛnam sɛ yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn abusua nti, ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛsusu sɛ Nyankopɔn tebea te sɛ sika anaa dwetɛ anaa ɔboɔ, adwini a onipa de ne nyansa ne n’adwene adie. 30#Aso 14.16; Luka 24.47 Ne saa nti Onyankopɔn abu n’ani agu mmerɛ ahodoɔ a wɔnnim no so, na afei deɛ, ɔhyɛ nnipa a ɛwɔ mmaa nyinaa sɛ wɔnsakyera wɔn adwene, 31#Aso 10.42; Rom 10.14 ɛfiri sɛ wayi da bi ato hɔ a ɔnam ɔbarima bi a wayi no asi hɔ so bɛbu wiase atɛn tenenee mu; ɔno na wama no asɔre afiri awufoɔ mu de adi adanseɛ sɛ nnipa nyinaa nnye nni.
32Na wɔtee awufoɔ sɔreɛ no, ebinom dii fɛw, na ebinom kaa sɛ: Yɛbɛtie wo wɔ asɛm yi ho bio. 33Enti Paulo firii wɔn nkyɛn kɔeɛ. 34Nso nnipa bi de wɔn ho bɔɔ ne ho, na wɔgye diiɛ; wɔn mu bi ne Dionisio a ɔka Areopago kuo ho ne ɔbaa bi a ne din de Damari ne ebinom a wɔka wɔn ho.

Na wɔtwaa mu wɔ Amfipoli ne Apolonia baa Tesalonika; ɛhɔ na Yudafoɔ hyiadan wɔ. Na sɛdeɛ Paulo taa yɛ no, ɔkɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn homeda mmiɛnsa ne wɔn kɔyɛɛ twerɛ nsɛm ho mpɛnsɛnpɛnsɛm. Ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ mu dii ho adanseɛ sɛ ɛtwa sɛ Kristo no hunu amane, na ɔsɔre firi awufoɔ mu. Na ɔse: Yesu a meka mo ne ho asɛm yi ara ne Kristo no. Na wɔn mu binom gye dii, na wɔde wɔn ho bɔɔ Paulo ne Silas ho, wɔne Helafoɔ nyamesurofoɔ no mu pii ne mmaa mpanimfoɔ no mu fa kɛseɛ.
Na Yudafoɔ no ani bereeɛ, na wɔfaa ahuhufoɔ no mu nnipa bɔne bi kaa wɔn ho, na wɔmaa nkurɔfoɔ no bɔɔ bum bɛhyiae, na wɔdanee kuro no ani butui, na wɔkɔtwaa Yason dan ho hyiaeɛ, hwehwɛɛ sɛ wɔyi wɔn firi adi de wɔn kɔma nkurɔfoɔ no. Na wɔanhu wɔn no, wɔtwee Yason ne anuanom no bi kɔmaa kuro no mu mpanimfoɔ, na wɔteateaa mu sɛ: Yeinom a wɔadane wiase ani abutuo no aba ha nso! Na Yason agye wɔn. Nso wɔn nyinaa bu Kaesare mmara no so ka sɛ, ɔhene foforɔ bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no Yesu. Na nkurɔfoɔ no ne ɔman mpanimfoɔ no tee yei no, ɛhaa wɔn pa ara. Na Yason ne wɔn a aka no dii agyinamu maa wɔn no, wɔgyaa wɔn ma wɔkɔe.

Na ntɛm ara anuanom no gyaa Paulo ne Silas kwan anadwo kɔɔ Beroia; na wɔduruu hɔ no, wɔkɔɔ Yudafoɔ hyiadan mu. Yudafoɔ a ɛwɔ ha no yɛ animdefoɔ sene wɔn a wɔwɔ Tesalonika no, ɛfiri sɛ wɔyii wɔn yam pefee gyee asɛm no, na daa na wɔhwehwɛ twerɛsɛm no mu sɛ nnoɔma no te saa anaa. Enti wɔn mu bebree gye dii, wɔne Helafoɔ mmaa a wɔwɔ din ne mmarima no mu fa kɛseɛ ara.
Na Yudafoɔ a wɔfiri Tesalonika no tee sɛ Paulo akɔka Nyankopɔn asɛm Beroia nso no, wɔbaa hɔ bɛhwanyanee ɛhɔfoɔ no nso. Enti ntɛm ara na anuanom no gyaa Paulo kwan sɛ ɔnkɔ mpoano; na Silas ne Timoteo deɛ, wɔtenaa hɔ. Na wɔn a wɔkɔgyaa Paulo no de no kɔɔ Atene. Ɔkraa wɔn sɛ Silas ne Timoteo mmra ne nkyɛn ntɛmntɛm no, wɔsii mu kɔe.

Na Paulo retwɛn wɔn wɔ Atene na ɔhunuu sɛ kuro no de wɔn ho ama abosonsom no, ɛyɛɛ no ahometeɛ pa ara. Enti hyiadan mu, na ɔne Yudafoɔ ne nyamesurofoɔ no yɛɛ nhwehwɛmu dendeenden, na edwa mu nso, daa na ɔne wɔn a ɔbɛto wɔn no dii anobaebaeɛ. Na Epikurofoɔ ne Stoafoɔ anyansapɛfoɔ bi nso ne no di anobaebaeɛ. Ebinom kaa sɛ: Ɔpɔtɔni yi se deɛn nie? Na ebinom se: Wayɛ sɛdeɛ ɔka abosom ahɔhoɔ bi ho asɛm. (Na ɔreka wɔn Yesu ne owusɔreɛ ho asɛmpa no.) Ɛnna wɔfaa no de no kɔɔ Areopago kaa sɛ: Wobɛtumi akyerɛ yɛn nkyerɛkyerɛ foforɔ yi ase? Ɛfiri sɛ nsɛm a wode aba yi yɛ yɛn aso mu asɛm foforɔ. Enti yɛpɛ sɛ yɛhunu deɛ ɛkyerɛ. Nso Atenefoɔ ne ahɔhoɔ a wɔabɛtena hɔ nyinaa nni hwee yɛ sɛ wɔbɛka anaa wɔbɛte asɛm foforɔ bie.
Na Paulo gyinaa Areopago mfimfini kaa sɛ: Atene mmarima, mahunu sɛ mowɔ gyidie wɔ nnoɔma pii mu dodo. Ɛfiri sɛ meretwa mu na mehwɛɛ nnoɔma a mosom no, mehunuu afɔrebukyia bi nso a wɔatwerɛ so sɛ: Onyame a wɔnni no dea. Enti deɛ monnim na mosɔre no no, ɔno na meka ne ho asɛm mekyerɛ mo yi. Ɔno na ɔma nnipa nyinaa nkwa ne ahome ne ade nyinaa; na ɔmaa nnipa wɔ aman nyinaa firi onipa baako mu tenaa asase so nyinaa, na wahyehyɛ mmerɛ ahodoɔ ne wɔn tenabea hyeɛ ato hɔ ama wɔn sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ Awurade sɛ ebia wɔbɛte ne nka na wɔahu no, nso ɔne yɛn mu biara ntam kwan nware. Na ɛnam sɛ yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn abusua nti, ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛsusu sɛ Nyankopɔn tebea te sɛ sika anaa dwetɛ anaa ɔboɔ, adwini a onipa de ne nyansa ne n’adwene adie. Ne saa nti Onyankopɔn abu n’ani agu mmerɛ ahodoɔ a wɔnnim no so, na afei deɛ, ɔhyɛ nnipa a ɛwɔ mmaa nyinaa sɛ wɔnsakyera wɔn adwene, ɛfiri sɛ wayi da bi ato hɔ a ɔnam ɔbarima bi a wayi no asi hɔ so bɛbu wiase atɛn tenenee mu; ɔno na wama no asɔre afiri awufoɔ mu de adi adanseɛ sɛ nnipa nyinaa nnye nni.
Na wɔtee awufoɔ sɔreɛ no, ebinom dii fɛw, na ebinom kaa sɛ: Yɛbɛtie wo wɔ asɛm yi ho bio. Enti Paulo firii wɔn nkyɛn kɔeɛ. Nso nnipa bi de wɔn ho bɔɔ ne ho, na wɔgye diiɛ; wɔn mu bi ne Dionisio a ɔka Areopago kuo ho ne ɔbaa bi a ne din de Damari ne ebinom a wɔka wɔn ho.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
